title: The three germ layers
caption: Gastrulation produces an embryo with three layers: ectoderm outside, mesoderm in the middle and endoderm inside. Every tissue of the body comes from one of them, so animals with three layers are triploblastic.
alt: Concentric rings for the ectoderm, mesoderm and endoderm of a gastrula, with the tissues each becomes: skin epidermis and nervous system; muscle, bone, blood, heart, kidneys and gonads; gut lining, respiratory lining, liver and pancreas.
description: Ectoderm (outer): the epidermis of the skin and the nervous system, including the brain and spinal cord.
Mesoderm (middle): muscle, bone, blood, heart, kidneys and gonads.
Endoderm (inner): the lining of the gut and respiratory tract, the liver and the pancreas.
